title: Dutch-Style Yellow Frittata
description: A simple and delicious breakfast dish made with eggs, cheese, and a hint of Dutch flavor.
instructions: 2. Whisk the eggs in a bowl and set aside.
3. Finely chop the onion and add it to the bowl with the eggs.
4. Crumble the Dutch cheese into the bowl and mix well.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
7. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
8. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes.
9. Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
10. Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
